text:
Maya (partnerships): FYI partners reported customers seeing charges during the marketplace flip. Looks like entitlements were provisioned but the activation webhook was delayed ~15m for a subset of accounts. :grimacing:

Hana (partner-success): Which partners and roughly how many customers affected? Any enterprise deals?

Maya (partnerships): Two hardware partners: NovaEdge and CloudSaturn. Partner success has 3 customers open, two SMB and one enterprise pilot.

Ravi (billing): Important: if events landed in the ledger before activation we need to avoid invoicing those events. Can integrations tag those events quickly?

Leah (integrations): I can. Plan: run a query for events where usage_ts < activation_ts AND activation_ts within the cutover window (2026-03-20T22:00:00Z - 2026-03-20T23:30:00Z). I'll add tag billing_hold=true. Example query: ```sql
SELECT id, acct, usage_ts, activation_ts, partner FROM marketplace_events
WHERE usage_ts < activation_ts
AND activation_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T23:30:00Z';
```

Diego (sre): Root cause: the activation-worker autoscale missed the metric due to a metric-name mismatch after the deploy. I reverted the metric name and scaled up the workers. backlog cleared. Watching for replay errors.

Ravi (billing): Good. Once Leah tags events we should compute the delta: total_billable_units(tagged) and keep them off invoices. We'll also need to attribute to partner contracts to issue credits (if billing rules apply).

Hana (partner-success): I'll gather partner-contract IDs and impacted account contacts. I can draft a customer-facing note and partner advisory. Keep messaging short: apology, what we did, next steps, and expected timeline for credits.

Maya (partnerships): Suggest short-term policy: during marketplace cutovers we flip ingestion to "non-invoiceable" mode by default for X minutes. If activation-provision confirms within 5m, then mark invoiceable; otherwise hold for manual reconciliation. Thoughts?

Diego (sre): That's doable: we can add a cutover flag that sets invoiceable=false at ingestion, then a scheduled job reconciles after activation events settle. Low-risk, I can scope a change and push a PR.

Leah (integrations): Implementation detail: add fields "cutover_flag":"true" and "entitlement_verified": "false". After replay, set entitlement_verified=true. Billing can filter on these two fields.

Ravi (billing): Works for billing automation. We'll need a reconciliation job: compare sum(tokens) where entitlement_verified=true against ledger totals and auto-generate credit memos if mismatch > 0.5% or > $50 (whichever bigger).

Maya (partnerships): Action items: 1) Diego deploy cutover-guard proposal PR and waveform (owner: Diego) 2) Leah run tag query and export CSV (owner: Leah) 3) Ravi freeze invoicing for affected accounts and prepare credit memos (owner: Ravi) 4) Hana prepare partner/customer comms and list of contract refs (owner: Hana). I'll prepare a short partner update after we have the CSV.

rbc-bot: NOTE: activation-worker autoscale reverted and replay job completed at 2026-03-21T00:05:25Z. replayed_events=1,208; queue=0.

Leah (integrations): CSV uploaded to secure drive: internal link (redwood-only). 1,208 events across 47 accounts. Sample row: {"event_id":"ev_9b8","account":"acct_402","usage_ts":"2026-03-20T22:11:09Z","activation_ts":"2026-03-20T22:26:34Z","partner":"NovaEdge"}

Ravi (billing): I'll start the freeze and run the reconciliation once entitlement_verified toggles true. Will loop Hana on credits for enterprise pilot.
